blocks.text: Origin / creation. Travelers dissatisfied with Last Loops sought unlike peoples, lost Paths, broken apertures, and changes beyond local prediction.
Identity / human status. Cyber-pet and little-people movements.
Importance. Reciprocal Seekers preserved awareness that an outside or radically different relation could change what a community was capable of becoming.
Decline or division. Some became translators and explorers; others pursued danger, stole rare forms, or exploited isolated peoples in the name of novelty.
Final status / surviving function. Divided rather than extinct. Their best rule—allow the encountered people to change the seeker and expand local choice—anticipates ethical player contact.
